ck_org_state_needs_country.name: ck_org_state_needs_country
ck_org_state_needs_country.value: "organizations"."state_id" is null or "organizations"."country_code" is not null

users_suspension_chk.name: users_suspension_chk
users_suspension_chk.value: ("users"."status" = 'suspended' and "users"."suspended_at" is not null and "users"."suspended_reason" is not null) or ("users"."status" = 'active' and "users"."suspended_at" is null and "users"."suspended_reason" is null)

user_identifiers_type_value_chk.name: user_identifiers_type_value_chk
user_identifiers_type_value_chk.value: ("user_identifiers"."type" = 'email' and "user_identifiers"."value" ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$') or ("user_identifiers"."type" = 'phone' and "user_identifiers"."value" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$') or ("user_identifiers"."type" = 'username' and "user_identifiers"."value" !~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$' and "user_identifiers"."value" !~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' and "user_identifiers"."value" !~ '[[:space:]]')

ck_item_expiry_settings_unit_and_value.name: ck_item_expiry_settings_unit_and_value
ck_item_expiry_settings_unit_and_value.value: ("item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_value" IS NULL AND "item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_unit" IS NULL) OR ("item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_value" IS NOT NULL AND "item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_unit" IS NOT NULL)

ck_item_warehouse_setting_stock_range.name: ck_item_warehouse_setting_stock_range
ck_item_warehouse_setting_stock_range.value:
"item_warehouse_settings"."minimum_stock" IS NULL OR "item_warehouse_settings"."maximum_stock" IS NULL
                OR "item_warehouse_settings"."minimum_stock" <= "item_warehouse_settings"."maximum_stock"

ck_warehouse_location_block.name: ck_warehouse_location_block
ck_warehouse_location_block.value:
("warehouse_locations"."is_blocked" and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_reason" is not null and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_at" is not null)
                or (not "warehouse_locations"."is_blocked" and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_reason" is null and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_at" is null)

ck_warehouse_location_measures.name: ck_warehouse_location_measures
ck_warehouse_location_measures.value:
("warehouse_locations"."max_weight" is null or "warehouse_locations"."max_weight" > 0) and ("warehouse_locations"."max_volume" is null or "warehouse_locations"."max_volume" > 0)
                and ("warehouse_locations"."width" is null or "warehouse_locations"."width" > 0) and ("warehouse_locations"."height" is null or "warehouse_locations"."height" > 0)
                and ("warehouse_locations"."depth" is null or "warehouse_locations"."depth" > 0)

ck_warehouse_address_len.name: ck_warehouse_address_len
ck_warehouse_address_len.value:
("warehouses"."address_line" is null or char_length("warehouses"."address_line") <= 200)
                and ("warehouses"."city" is null or char_length("warehouses"."city") <= 100)
                and ("warehouses"."region" is null or char_length("warehouses"."region") <= 100)
                and ("warehouses"."postal_code" is null or char_length("warehouses"."postal_code") <= 20)

ck_warehouse_virtual_no_address.name: ck_warehouse_virtual_no_address
ck_warehouse_virtual_no_address.value:
"warehouses"."type" = 'physical'
                or ("warehouses"."address_line" is null and "warehouses"."city" is null and "warehouses"."region" is null
                    and "warehouses"."postal_code" is null and "warehouses"."country_code" is null)

ck_batch_dates.name: ck_batch_dates
ck_batch_dates.value: "batches"."manufactured_on" is null or "batches"."expires_on" is null or "batches"."expires_on" >= "batches"."manufactured_on"

ck_batch_shelf_life_unit_and_value.name: ck_batch_shelf_life_unit_and_value
ck_batch_shelf_life_unit_and_value.value: ("batches"."shelf_life_value" IS NULL AND "batches"."shelf_life_unit" IS NULL) OR ("batches"."shelf_life_value" IS NOT NULL AND "batches"."shelf_life_unit" IS NOT NULL)

ux_stock_movement_org_source.name: ux_stock_movement_org_source
ux_stock_movement_org_source.where: "stock_movements"."source_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."reversal_of_id" is null

ck_stock_movement_source.name: ck_stock_movement_source
ck_stock_movement_source.value: "stock_movements"."source_id" is null or "stock_movements"."source_type" is not null

ck_stock_movement_text_len.name: ck_stock_movement_text_len
ck_stock_movement_text_len.value:
("stock_movements"."source_type" is null or char_length("stock_movements"."source_type") <= 40)
                and ("stock_movements"."source_ref" is null or char_length("stock_movements"."source_ref") <= 64)
                and ("stock_movements"."note" is null or char_length("stock_movements"."note") <= 500)
